biotools.summary: A suite of methods (including ComBAT, Harmony, Seurat, scVI, and Scanorama) for performing batch correction in large-scale mass spectrometry imaging (MALDI MSI) experiments. The methods are implemented across R and Python and are used to reduce technical variance while preserving biological variation.
